# PANO Vacuum — Custom Vacuum Chambers & Precision Manufacturing

> PANO Vacuum Machinery Technology (Changshu) Co., Ltd. manufactures custom vacuum chambers, precision-machined components and vacuum-tight assemblies for semiconductor equipment, vacuum coating/process tools and new-energy equipment makers. Drawing review → precision machining → welding & leak testing → inspection & delivery, all under one roof in Changshu, Jiangsu, China.

## Capabilities (details on home page)
- Precision CNC machining for vacuum-grade components
- Vacuum-tight welding: TIG and automated processes
- Surface finishing in a controlled clean welding environment
- Helium leak testing to the 1×10⁻⁹ Pa·m³/s order (UL1000-class), per-chamber before shipment
- 30 kW laser cutting · 400 t / 6.2 m press brake · H200 floor boring-mill (4 m-class) · 40+ welding stations · 50 t overhead crane

## FAQ (10 questions, on home page)
- Chamber size: multi-ton class, per drawing; 50 t crane supports full assembly
- Materials: 304L / SUS316L stainless steel as standard, per drawing
- Leak testing: helium mass-spectrometer, 1×10⁻⁹ Pa·m³/s order, verified per chamber
- Lead time: per drawing complexity, committed milestone schedule in quotation
- Certifications: in progress (SEMI-related standards, AWS welding systems); customer audits welcome
- How to start: send drawing (PDF / DWG / STEP) → drawing review, DFM suggestions, quotation
- Minimum order: single-piece custom work accepted
- Warranty: contractual terms; every unit ships with inspection records
- Overseas support: full English process, export packing & documentation
- Payment: per contract (e.g., 30/70 or agreed LC)
